title: ARKNIGHTS 1st ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION EVENT OPEN
lines: ARKNIGHTS 1 st ANNIVERSARY LIMITED-TIME CELEBRATION EVENT PART 1
01 NEW STORYLINE RELEASE: EP07 THE BIRTH OF TRAGEDY
STARTS FROM: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 6-18
02 ANNIVERSARY REGISTRATION EVENT OPEN
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Awakening Commemoration Permit] * 1 as log-in reward
NOTE:
[Awakening Commemoration Permit] can only be used in Exclusive Headhunting [Cremation Last Wish]
This log-in reward only can be obtained once for each account
[Awakening Commemoration Permit] will be expired at January 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
03 ANNIVERSARY SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 2, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7) - January 30, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can sign in for 14 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, New Operator [THRM-EX] * 1
Day 2: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, LMD * 40000
Day 3: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 20
Day 4: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Optimized Device * 2
Day 5: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Chip Catalyst * 2
Day 6: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Furniture Part * 200
Day 7: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Commemorative Anniversary Wall Lamp * 1
Day 8: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Skill Summary – 2 * 10
Day 9: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Commemorative Anniversary Carpet * 1
Day 10: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, White Horse Kohl * 3
Day 11: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Commemorative Anniversary Bed * 1
Day 12: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Orirock Concentration * 5
Day 13: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Furniture Part * 200
Day 14: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Amiya Outfit [Fresh Fastener]
NOTE:
The Emergency Sanity Potions from this event will be expired at February 5, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
04 EXCLUSIVE HEADHUNTING – CREMATION LAST WISH OPEN
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Exclusive Headhunting, "Cremation Last Wish", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Exclusive Headhunting:
★★★★★★: W [Limited] / Weedy
★★★★★: Elysium
NOTE:
New Operator W can ONLY be obtained from "Cremation Last Wish" and will NOT appear in other Standard Headhunting
05 FREE EXCLUSIVE HEADHUNTING EVERYDAY
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can do one free roll in [Cremation Last Wish] everyday
NOTE:
The free roll will be refreshed at 04:00 everyday
The unused free roll chance will be refreshed at 04:00 each day, which cannot be cumulated
06 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE AT HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "Cremation Last Wish"
★★★★★★: W [Limited] / Weedy
★★★★★: Elysium
NOTE:
Limited new Operator W can ONLY be obtained from "Cremation Last Wish"
New Operator Weedy, Elysium will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
New Operator THRM-EX can be obtained by clearing main story and sign-in event
07 OPERATOR SAVAGE FREE TO CLAIM FOR LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: After the event begins, 5* Operator Savage * 1 will be sent to players via in-game mail
SENDING TIME: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
REQUIREMENT:
All the players who have logged in and created a character before December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7), including guest accounts.
NOTE:
Players who already have Operator Savage will obtain Savage’s Token * 1 from this mail, which can be used to improve the Potential of Savage
08 NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Bloodline of Combat – Stronghold for Saria
Bloodline of Combat – Distinguished Visitor for Angelina
Bloodline of Combat – Homecoming for GreyThroat
Bloodline of Combat – Refined Horrormare for Lappland
Bloodline of Combat – Seventh Night’s Awakened for Midnight
Bloodline of Combat – Titleless Code for Executor
09 NEW FURNITURE SET SARKAZ MERCENARY LOUNGE
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Part of the brand new Furniture set, Sarkaz Mercenary Lounge will be available at the Store for a limited time.
10 SUPPLIES & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
11 ORIGINIUM FIRST TIME PURCHASE RESET
RESET TIME: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Reset all players' Originium first purchase bonus. After reset, players can get double Originium for the first time purchase again.
12 ANNIVERSARY PACKAGES AVAILABLE
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packages will be available at Store for a limited-time
[RHODES ISLAND ANNIVERSARY PACKAGE]
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)

INCLUDES: Originite Prime * 90, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, LMD * 200000, Strategic Battle Record * 20, Tactical Battle Record * 50, Frontline Battle Record * 100, Skill Summary – 3 * 20, Skill Summary – 2 * 50, Chip Catalyst * 4, Furniture Part * 500
[DOCTOR’S CHOICE PACKAGE]
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
INCLUDES: Top Operator Transfer Permit * 1, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1
[Top Operator Transfer Permit]: Allows you to select a 6-star Operator from a past Headhunting Pool up to and including "Enthusiasm, Expansion, Explosion."
(Ch’en, Blaze, Exusiai, Siege, Ifrit, Hoshiguma, Shining, SilverAsh, Nightingale, Eyjafjalla, Hellagur, Saria, Mostima, Magallan, Skadi, Angelina, Schwarz)
NOTE:
All [Top Operator Transfer Permit] will be expired at: February 27, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
13 RECRUITMENT OPERATORS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment
★★★★★★: Skadi
★★★★★: Swire
★★★★★: Nightmare
★★★★: Greyy
★★★★: Beehunter
★★★: Popukar
★★★: Midnight
★★★: Catapult
★★★: Spot
★: THRM-EX
NOTE:
When Recruitment Operators update, the Recruitment tags will be forced to refresh. Please pay attention to related update notices.
ARKNIGHTS 1 st ANNIVERSARY LIMITED-TIME CELEBRATION EVENT PART 2
01 EP07 EXTREME MODE
STARTS FROM: January 6, 2021, 16:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear all stages in Episode 7
02 COLLECTING GUERILLA SQUAD MEMBER BADGE TO REDEEM LIMITED REWARDS
DURATION: January 2, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7) – January 16, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can collect [Guerilla Squad Member Badge]. When badges reach a certain number, players can obtain corresponding rewards.
MAIN REWARDS:
Bloodline of Combat – Dreadnaught for Beagle
Emergency Sanity Potion, Furniture Part, Battle Record, Recruitment Permit, Elite Materials etc.
NOTE:
The Emergency Sanity Potions from this event will be expired at January 25, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
03 ALL STAGES LIMITED-TIME SPECIAL DROP
DURATION: January 2, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7) – January 16, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following items will be added to all Sanity consuming stages (except Annihilation stages) as special drop for a limited time:
Emergency Sanity Sampler (Can be used to restore Sanity)
32-hour Strategic Ration (Filled with an assortment of supplies and materials)
NOTE:
The Emergency Sanity Potions from this event will be expired at January 25, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
